messages.content:
Fuel-efficiency report

Distance: 360 km
Fuel consumed: 45 litres

Consumption = (45 ÷ 360) × 100 = 12.5 L/100 km.

Interpretation: The vehicle used an average of 12.5 litres per 100 km. Lower L/100 km means better fuel efficiency; whether this is good depends on the vehicle and driving conditions.

Independent arithmetic check: 12.5 × 3.6 = 45 litres over 360 km, matching the original reading.
